# Academic Guidance Skill

## Preconditions

- University PDFs remain local and ignored unless explicit redistribution permission exists.
- Maintain a versioned index describing title, course/topic, source, and intended use.
- Distinguish university requirements from project conventions and general knowledge.

## Execution

1. Consult local academic material only when the task concerns a rubric or course topic.
2. Extract requirements and map each to repository evidence.
3. Record source and confidence; do not invent criteria.
4. Keep generated summaries original and concise.
5. Escalate conflicts between academic guidance and security or production safety.
